Remaining defect: repeat click on same in-page anchor fails to re-scroll.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: On Home, click [data-testid=information-jump-markets], then scroll elsewhere, click the same link again. Expected: viewport returns to #markets. Actual: location remains #markets but scroll position stays away from target. RCA: App-level hash scroll is implemented in Scroll useEffect with dependency [pathname, hash]; same-hash click does not update route state, so effect is not re-fired and no explicit manual scroll handler is attached to these links. Mitigation: force navigation state change or add explicit click handler for same-hash links to call scrollIntoView on target.
